thread:
incident-bot: PAGING: Elevated 5xx + latency observed in eu-west-1 impacting Hosted API and Dedicated pools. Auto-alert from observability (error-rate > 5% for 3m).
anya.patel: Seeing spike in auth/provider 502s from cloud API egress in eu-west-1. Topology: hosted frontend -> auth proxy -> AWS STS / observability -> downstream.
marcus.chang: Confirmed. Metrics: 99p latency up ~3x across hosted endpoints, dedicated pool eu-west-1 experiencing increased queue lengths.
oncall-sre: Oncall here — taking lead. Running initial checks. Can someone paste the top failing traces?
anya.patel: Log snippet: ```
ERROR auth: upstream call failed: POST https://sts.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com - 502 Bad Gateway - connection reset by peer
stack=auth/credentials request_id=req-8f3a
```
marcus.chang: Rolling tail of access logs shows STS 502/504 and some 429s from observability ingestion endpoint. Likely provider-side egress throttling/backpressure.
ops-lead: Is this visible to customers? Any SLO breaches?
support-sre: Yes — Cx reports: AcmePay (dedicated eu-west-1) seeing timeouts when calling Redwood hosted API. Support ticket #7892 opened.
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1879 (auto) — Severity P1 (multi-customer impact). Paging oncall-sre and ops-lead.
oncall-sre: Mitigation plan (short): 1) Pause non-essential observability ingestion from eu-west-1 2) Route new Hosted API traffic to eu-central-1 fallback for latency-sensitive customers 3) Increase Dedicated pool autoscale/executor limits in eu-west-1 4) Contact AWS/third-party status.
marcus.chang: I'm starting a routing override to steer traffic. Command: ```
# temporary routing rule
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/internal/route-override \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"region":"eu-west-1","fallback":"eu-central-1","match":"hosted:latency>200"}'
```
anya.patel: Also flipping observability forwarder to buffer mode to drop non-critical telemetry. Patch: set FORWARDER_MODE=buffer in eu-west-1.
ops-lead: James, can you spin up extra capacity for dedicated pools? Increase pool size by +20% and extend burst window.
james.lee: On it, triggering job now. ETA ~3m. Stack job id: deploy-4721.
support-sre: Notifying impacted customers via support playbook. Draft status: "We're investigating elevated errors for eu-west-1, traffic is being routed to fallback regions where possible. Updates every 15m."
oncall-sre: I've notified AWS support and opened ticket with STS/edge team — case #AWSS-112233. They report an ongoing egress networking issue in eu-west-1 affecting API endpoints.
status-bot: Status page update queued: "Partial service disruption in eu-west-1 affecting API calls and dedicated pools; mitigation in progress."
marcus.chang: After routing override, error-rate dropped to 1.6% in fallback region but eu-west-1 still elevated. Queue lengths decreasing slightly after scaling.
anya.patel: Observability ingestion still showing backpressure from vendor; temporarily disabled external traces to reduce egress.
ops-lead: Good. Keep rolling routing override for hosted customers only; dedicated customers who pinned region — we need to notify and offer migration.
support-sre: Reaching out to top-10 dedicated customers in eu-west-1 with migration options and temporary credits.
oncall-sre: Handoff: I'm going to escalate to escalation channel (eng-sre) and then hand to night oncall at 1749876900. Ops-lead will remain as incident lead.
ops-lead: I'll stay on the incident and coordinate customer comms and postmortem ops. Anyone have a reproducible test?
marcus.chang: Quick repro curl against hosted endpoint: ```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
# returns 502 with upstream STS auth failure in trace
```
james.lee: Dedicated pool autoscale succeeded, added 4 nodes to eu-west-1. Metrics show CPU stable but network egress errors persist.
anya.patel: AWS support replied: they see elevated transient errors in STS and some NAT gateway saturation incidents in eu-west-1. They've routed to network team, ETA unknown.
incident-bot: Reminder: incident timeline timer started. Next update in 15 minutes.
support-sre: Customer impact summary for ops: - Hosted API: degraded latency, transient 5xx for ~30-45m for eu-west-1 origin traffic (fallback in place for many). - Dedicated pools: increased latency and errors for pinned-region customers; some experienced timeouts. - Top impacted customers: AcmePay, LumenPay, StripeFlow (notifications sent).
ops-lead: Action items: * keep routing override active * confirm dedicated customers have migration paths * escalate billing/credits for affected * gather logs for postmortem (include trace ids).
oncall-sre: Handoff note: leaving at 1749876900 — ops-lead will be incident lead. Patch notes and runbook steps in the incident doc.
ops-lead: Ack. Will post 15m update and create incident timeline. After AWS clears, we'll run degraded traffic soak and then rollback routing override.
marcus.chang: Post-mitigation check: after 25m error-rate in eu-west-1 down to ~0.9% and latency creeping toward baseline. Looks like partial recovery on provider side.
anya.patel: Observability vendor confirmed they had a burst limit causing 429s — they've raised the limit for us and backpressure is subsiding.
support-sre: Closing communicated tickets for customers who acknowledged. Still keeping P1 open until eu-west-1 fully healthy.
status-bot: Status page updated: "Mitigation in place, partial recovery observed. Customers routed to fallback regions where possible. Continuing monitoring."
ops-lead: Thanks everyone. After incident, schedule postmortem with root cause analysis: AWS egress/NAT saturation + observability vendor rate limiting. Follow-ups: resilience for STS calls (caching credentials longer), smarter routing fallback, dedicated pool migration docs, expanded monitoring for egress saturations.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: severity lowered to P2 at 1749876925 (mitigations effective, some customers still impacted).
ops-lead: I'll run handoff to night oncall at 1749876945. Keep channels updated if anything regresses.
support-sre: final note: AcmePay asked for a timeline for region-migration; ops-lead to coordinate.
ops-lead: Noted. Posting incident doc link and runbook in eng-sre. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:\
